answer: Mutual insurance pools make sybils pay for their neighbours. A grove of ten stakes 100 credits each: one proven fake burns all ten stakes, so members vet newcomers and check real ties. Stakes stay locked until a clean epoch, when honest members keep full weight and share the pool's nectar. An audit samples one pool in ten to catch shell-pool farming, and any member may whisper a challenge freezing a suspect pool. The k-th fake needs a fresh 100-credit stake, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits; stakes bind to one key, never reused.
